tenderSchedule.title: ANIMAL BIRTH CONTROL - STRAY DOGS
tenderSchedule.deptName: Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department
tenderSchedule.locationName: RDPR Taluka Panchayat Office Bengaluru East

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Scanned copy of registration certificate issued by AWBI

Scanned copies of experience of conducting ABC operations for dogs supported by documentary proof such as Certificate/Work Done Certificate from the Agency/Local Bodies to whom services were provided.
Details of number of proposed dog-catching vehicles, dog catchers, operation theaters, veterinary doctors, other staff, other equipment and facilities available (enclose relevant documents

Undertaking to arrange for the required facilities like operation theaters, post-operative care, dog catching van, dog catchers, Drivers and qualified, registered veterinary professionals and other supporting staff
Scanned copy of GST Registration and Pan Card of the bidder

Scanned copy of annual turnover certificate duly attested by Chartered Accountant. Tenderer in its name should have in the last 5 years i.e. 2019-20 to 2023-24 achieved in at least 2 financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs. 20 lakhs
